title: Compliance Bulletin on Military Lending Act and Servicemembers Civil Relief Act Rate Caps for the Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan
content:
This bulletin sets out the two federal rate caps that bear on the Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan and the figures the product sets for them.

### 1. Military Lending Act

For a borrower who is a covered member of the armed forces or a dependent, the Military Lending Act caps the Military Annual Percentage Rate at 36.0%. Every tier's APR is below that cap.

### 2. Servicemembers Civil Relief Act

For a borrower who enters active military service after the loan was made, interest above 6.0% is forgiven for the period of service on written request under the Servicemembers Civil Relief Act. The capped rate overrides the tier's APR, and no other rate is applied. The rate that applies is the lower of the tier's APR and the 6.0% cap.

### Cap figures by tier

| Tier | Tier APR | Military Lending Act cap on the Military APR | Servicemembers Civil Relief Act cap | Lower of the tier APR and the 6.0% cap |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Payroll Loan 500 | 24.99% | 36.0% | 6.0% | 6.0% |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 1000 | 22.99% | 36.0% | 6.0% | 6.0% |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 2000 | 19.99% | 36.0% | 6.0% | 6.0% |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 3000 | 17.99% | 36.0% | 6.0% | 6.0% |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 4000 | 15.99% | 36.0% | 6.0% | 6.0% |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 5000 | 13.99% | 36.0% | 6.0% | 6.0% |

### Points of judgement

- **Which act.** The Military Lending Act cap concerns a borrower who is a covered member or a dependent. The Servicemembers Civil Relief Act cap concerns a borrower who enters active military service after the loan was made.
- **What the Servicemembers Civil Relief Act cap needs.** Three things together: active military service that began after the loan was made, the period of service, and a written request. The interest forgiven is the interest above 6.0% for that period.
- **One rate.** Where the cap applies, the capped rate takes the place of the tier's APR; no other rate is applied alongside it.

### Hypothetical case

A hypothetical borrower holds a Paystride Payroll Loan 3000 loan at 17.99% and afterwards enters active military service, sending a written request. For the period of service the lower of 17.99% and 6.0% is 6.0%, so 6.0% is the rate for that period, and the interest above 6.0% is forgiven.
